instruction_templates.2ab3c8d349761a1a: You are answering an economics question for a student revising introductory microeconomics. Give your best response using the question and any supplied assessment guidance. Use no external tools. The question image is authoritative for graphs, tables, symbols, and any text-extraction ambiguity. Return the specified JSON envelope. Put the substantive written answer in answer_markdown. Draw every requested diagram in diagrams using the declarative scene format. Each scene is an actual drawing on a0..100 horizontal/vertical coordinate canvas: polyline connects the supplied points, polygon fills the supplied vertices, text places its label at its first point. Use axis labels, labeled curves/points, and shaded polygons where required; coordinates are drawing positions, not necessarily economic values. A verbal graph description does not replace a requested drawing. Use at most five diagrams, forty elements per diagram, and30points per element. Keep labels short (at most12words); do not place prose explanations inside diagrams. A table or payoff matrix may be written as a Markdown table in answer_markdown.
